title: Automation Engineer - HVAC
description:
Automation Design \& Development

* Design automation solutions for AHU manufacturing and testing applications.
* Develop PLC, HMI, and SCADA programs as per project requirements.
* Prepare automation architecture, I/O lists, and control philosophies.
* Select suitable automation components including PLCs, HMIs, VFDs, sensors, and communication devices.
* Support electrical design team during control panel development.

Programming \& Integration

* Develop and modify PLC programs using ladder logic, function block, and structured text.
* Configure and program HMI screens for machine operation and monitoring.
* Integrate PLCs with SCADA systems, VFDs, sensors, and field instruments.
* Establish communication using Modbus, Profinet, Profibus, Ethernet/IP, BACnet, and other industrial protocols.

Testing \& Commissioning

* Conduct FAT (Factory Acceptance Test) and SAT (Site Acceptance Test).
* Perform machine testing, troubleshooting, and validation.
* Commission AHU testing stations and automation\-controlled equipment.
* Support installation and startup activities at customer sites.

Troubleshooting \& Maintenance

* Diagnose automation\-related breakdowns and control system faults.
* Provide technical support to production and maintenance departments.
* Implement corrective and preventive actions to minimize downtime.
* Maintain backup copies of PLC, HMI, and SCADA programs.

Documentation

* Prepare technical documentation, operating manuals, and commissioning reports.
* Create I/O lists, cable schedules, and automation drawings.
* Maintain project records, revision histories, and software backups.

Process Improvement

* Identify opportunities for automation and process optimization.
* Improve production efficiency through automation initiatives.
* Support Industry 4\.0 and digitalization projects.
* Participate in continuous improvement and cost\-reduction activities.

Required Skills

* PLC Programming (Siemens, Allen Bradley, Schneider, Delta, Mitsubishi, Omron, etc.)
* HMI/SCADA Development
* VFD Configuration \& Troubleshooting
* Industrial Communication Protocols
* Electrical Control Panels
* Instrumentation \& Sensors
* AutoCAD Electrical (Preferred)
* Industrial Networking
* Troubleshooting \& Root Cause Analysis
* Project Execution \& Documentation

Pay: ₹25,000\.00 \- ₹35,000\.00 per month

Benefits:

* Food provided
* Paid sick time
* Paid time off
* Provident Fund

Work Location: In person
